subject: Mobile Development
title: The Failed App Stores
description: A quick, practical guide to The Failed App Stores.

hook.text: Apple and Google weren't the only ones who tried. Others built app stores too.

buildup.text: BlackBerry App World, Windows Phone Store, and Amazon Appstore all launched with fanfare.

discovery.text: Without enough users, developers wouldn't build apps. Without apps, users wouldn't come.

twist.text: Microsoft reportedly paid developers millions to port apps to Windows Phone. It still failed.

climax.text: Network effects created a winner-take-most market. Only two app stores survived.

punchline.text: In app stores, second place is the same as last.

quiz.question: Why did alternative app stores fail?
options: Not enough users or developers — a chicken-and-egg problem
